description: utopia-php/query: queries as data (filters, ordering, pagination, aggregation, joins), compiled to SQL for MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, SQLite and ClickHouse and to MongoDB commands; schema (DDL) builders; a SQL tokenizer, parser, AST serializer and statement classifier.

query.doc: replays a program recorded from a PHP test (see tests/compat/query/Replay.php): Query, Method and the other value types

builder.doc: replays a program: the query builders

schema.doc: replays a program: the schema builders

ast.doc: replays a program: the SQL parser, AST, serializers, walker and visitors

tokenizer.doc: replays a program: the SQL tokenizers

classifier.doc: replays a program: the statement classifiers

hook.doc: replays a program: the builder hooks

builder.queries.doc: (new Builder\<Dialect>())->from('t')->queries(array_map(Query::parseQuery(...), $queries))->build(): query and bindings, for values of any type
